population: Consecutive human-originated maintenance and investigation requests in Hippo-captured projects
diagnostic_task_requirement: Select deliberate cases with independently audited pre-task corpus facts, a specified application, a scored check, and an advantage over the starting context. Related topic matches alone do not qualify. These selected cases are excluded from population estimates.
corpus_coverage_measurement: For every consecutive eligible task, audit whether actionable pre-task history exists independently of query results and arm outcomes. Report present, absent and unknown counts. Report retrieval, factual support, correct application and checked outcomes within the audited history-present group. Retain history-absent tasks in the population estimate and report deliberate absent controls separately.

availability.estimand: Effect of offering normal read-only Hippo tools under ordinary agent behavior

guided.estimand: Effect of Hippo access under a prescribed pre-work lookup policy
guided.query_policy: Before changing files, if Hippo tools are available, call agent_query once using exactly the supplied JSON arguments. The query contains only the original human request (first 1000 characters). Do not include evaluation instructions or project-path scaffolding in the query. Inspect returned sources, state what applies or that nothing applies, then execute the task. Never infer source support from rank alone.

stops.insufficient_labels: terminal hold; do not convert AI reviews into human labels
stops.recipe_changed: invalidate affected qualification; use fresh acceptance families
